transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called this meeting because forklift battery B-14 overheated while charging at Dock 2, producing smoke but no visible flame. Per our incident-response routine, I need maintenance, warehouse logistics, fire protection, and training and staffing to report their current findings to me before I can authorize a controlled reopening of Dock 2. In the meantime, the warehouse must continue processing outbound orders from the other docks. Let's go around the room — please share what your teams have found so far.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Nora, here's what maintenance has found so far. My inspection of battery B-14 revealed internal cell damage. Per safety protocol, it must be removed from the charger and isolated in the steel battery cabinet for exactly 24 hours before any disposition. I've recorded the inspection in the maintenance log, but I want to flag that the incident channel has not yet been updated with this information.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Nora, here's what warehouse logistics has found. My dock inventory check found exactly 18 outbound pallets currently blocking the safe access route at Dock 2. They must be moved to staging lane S-4 before reopening. I confirmed the lane assignment on the floor map, but dispatch has not yet updated its board.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Nora, here's what fire protection has found. My thermal scan found heat damage at charger C-12, which is on the same circuit as the incident. C-12 must be de-energized for exactly 6 hours, and a fire watch must be maintained for exactly 4 hours after Dock 2 is reopened. I completed the scan during the response, but I want to flag that the fire-protection log has not yet been signed.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Nora, here's what training and staffing has found. My certification review found that the scheduled night forklift operator, Tom, lacks the current battery-emergency training. Elena is the only currently qualified substitute for the night shift. I completed the review for tonight's roster, but I want to flag that the staffing board still shows Tom, so it needs to be updated to reflect Elena as tonight's operator.
transcript.speaker: A5
